numerical_amendment: The first execution stopped at N=100 million when the 5e-11 CDF check could not reach tolerance (estimated error 1.62e-9). Use 1e-7 with a separate 5e-9 check; record both errors and probability near coverage thresholds. This changes numerical tolerances only, not candidates, data, endpoints or decision gates. Preserve the incomplete first artifact.
purpose: Separate existence of a coherent mode-preserving kernel from measurement calibration. No production selection or cohort testing.
observations: Complete, disjoint integer count categories; C and N=sum(C) are immutable. Supplied normalization s maps a fraction to N*p/s, or a resampled count to Z/s. Known exposures isolate counting uncertainty.

constructions.multinomial_bootstrap: q=(C+w)/(N+1), with fixed positive weights summing to one; Z~Multinomial(N,q). Marginal Binomial(N,q_g) has unique mode C_g. This is smoothed resampling, not the integrated Dirichlet posterior predictive or a posterior for latent abundance.
constructions.continuous_contraction: m=C/N; Q~Dirichlet(C+alpha); independent shared U~Uniform(0,1); P=m+U*(Q-m). Marginal densities increase up to m and decrease afterwards; draws and means conserve composition. The post-processing is not itself justified by Bayes' rule. Evaluate total prior budgets 1 and G as explicit diagnostic contrasts, not a tuning search.

comparators: The uncontracted Dirichlet marginals under each of the two prespecified prior budgets isolate the effect of uniform contraction. They retain their previously established failure to preserve individual physical modes.
checks: Prove and check actual marginal modes, positive zero variance, count immutability, normalization, conserved sums and independent joint-sampling moments.
Audit the zero budget of the ENTIRE mode-preserving multinomial family, not just the uniform allocation.

Compute exact repeated-binomial central/upper interval coverage, mean bias/RMSE and kernel-mixture variance. Quantiles of a bootstrap distribution are diagnostic percentile intervals, not claimed exact confidence or predictive intervals.
Compute continuous coverage through an independent CDF integral with reported quadrature error; repeat at tighter tolerance and bound ambiguity at interval edges.
Derive high-information calibration analytically before interpreting simulations: uniform contraction of a Gaussian error has variance one third and a different 95% quantile.
Show that the uniform allocation is sensitive to the declared gene universe. Do not optimize the prior after observing outcomes.
decision_gate: Structural success is necessary but insufficient. Reject any construction as a ready measurement model if uncertainty effectively collapses at zero, high-information nominal 95% intervals systematically undercover, or prior-dominated shifts remain. No new significance test, FDR certification, technical-overdispersion claim, or package behavior. The continuous example can establish feasibility even when it fails calibration.
